options.desc: Configuration specifying decay rate (`alpha`, `span`, `com`, `halfLife`), `adjust`, `minSamples`, `ignoreNulls`, and optional `by`.

adjust.desc: When `true`, divides by the decaying adjustment factor in beginning periods to account for imbalance in relative weightings.

alpha.desc: Smoothing factor `alpha` directly in `(0, 1]`. Mutually exclusive with `span`, `halfLife`, and `com`.

bias.desc: When `false`, applies sample bias correction; when `true`, computes population moments without bias correction.

by.desc: Optional timestamp/index column name or expression used to scale `halfLife` decay by elapsed time deltas.

com.desc: Decay in terms of center of mass (`alpha = 1 / (1 + com)`), where `com >= 0`.

fisher.desc: When `true` (default), computes excess kurtosis (Fisher's definition, subtracting 3.0); when `false`, computes Pearson's kurtosis.

halfLife.desc: Decay in terms of half-life (`alpha = 1 - exp(-ln(2) / halfLife)`), as a positive number or duration string.

ignoreNulls.desc: When `true`, ignores missing/null values when calculating weights; when `false`, weights decay across null positions.

minSamples.desc: Minimum number of non-null observations in window required to produce a value (otherwise `null`).

span.desc: Decay in terms of span (`alpha = 2 / (span + 1)`), where `span >= 1`.
